This ointment formed a great protective barrier and quickly soothed my dry, cracked patches—especially helpful overnight for feet and elbows—though it’s very greasy and the 5oz tube ran out faster than I expected. Works really well at locking in moisture — cleared up my dry patches and softened cracked heels within a few days; the calendula is a nice touch. It’s very thick and greasy so it can feel heavy and can stain clothes/bedding, which is the only drawback.

This product felt thick and protective and did a great job softening cracked hands and heels overnight—worked well on cuticles and lips too without irritating my face. I’m not convinced it’s worth more than plain Vaseline, though, so I wouldn’t repurchase at full price unless I saw a clear ingredient benefit or a sale.

Worked well overnight on cracked hands, feet and lips—thick and occlusive so areas were noticeably softer by morning. Feels essentially like a fancy petroleum jelly though, so I wouldn’t repurchase at full price given cheaper alternatives do the same job.
